summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration with Spark 4.1, enhancements to read restrictions, and the management of metadata size. Proposals for the REST specification and the addition of a 'Tags' field in Iceberg V4 metadata are also under consideration.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work including async reader improvements
Discussion on offloading snapshot history from metadata.json
Proposal to add a 'Tags' field in Iceberg V4 metadata
